question.text: Per SEBI (PM) Regulations 2020, discretionary portfolio managers MUST disclose performance using:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI PM Regs mandate TWRR because it removes the effect of external cash flows (client-driven) and reflects the manager's skill. The Trap: MWRR is client-specific (depends on timing of their deposits/withdrawals); arithmetic mean overstates over multi-year periods. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A tests for Distributor side; XXI-B tests for PM compliance.
